lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete high-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately five longitudinal rows along the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a regular spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical transverse bands of elevated luminance intersect the longitudinal spot rows, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal carinae are visible on the upper lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light upper and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a dense field of high-luminance spots that decrease in diameter and density towards the posterior and distal margins.
